title: FAST_TDA two-photon external qualification
summary: Qualify the resident TDA two-photon tensor on one immutable orbital reference and compare it separately with the SOS and response two-photon observables produced by std2.
gates: identical wfn.xtb orbital reference for all resident and external calculations
resident TDA roots first pass ordinary std2 TDA energy parity
resident TDA tensor and isotropic strength use a direct dense-resolvent oracle
pure-TDA external parity is reconstructed from ordinary std2 roots, tda.exc ground moments and std2 -s2s state-to-state moments
std2 SOS2PA and 2PA are reported as sTD-DFT comparisons and never relabelled as TDA parity
tensor comparisons account only for the arbitrary target-state phase
executable and orbital-reference checksums are frozen in the result
coordinate_policy: The orbital reference, atom order, geometry and Cartesian frame are immutable throughout the qualification.
backend_policy: FAST_TDA remains resident; std2 is invoked only as the frozen external qualification oracle through this KeyMaker protocol.
